supersession_reason: The official CMS QIC decision-summary API is now the primary public source for this track; DMHC remains a secondary candidate pending payload access.
purpose: Evaluate regulator-facing determination and rationale summaries from a real public IMR source. This track is intentionally separate from end-to-end denial and appeal reconstruction.

supports: case-level regulator determination when an accepted source exposes it
regulator-authored findings or rationale summaries when an accepted source exposes them
regulator-outcome comparisons after source acceptance and local evaluation
does_not_support: a verified denial_reason unless the source explicitly defines one
the internal appeal submission or decision
the complete clinical chart or evidence packet
the policy version and criteria applied to the denial

findings.status: regulator_summary_only; keep local when narrative reuse is not cleared

denial_reason.status: nullable; use only when the selected source explicitly defines the field

appeal_type.status: nullable_unverified; never infer from a similar filter or count

prior_authorization.status: nullable_unverified; do not label every external review as prior authorization

acceptance.unlock_condition: A human owner records the selected source, provenance reconciliation, reuse decision, technical privacy disposition, and explicit field mappings in this manifest.
